first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person with long light-colored hair, wearing a beige patterned short-sleeved top and a long white skirt, sitting barefoot on the Dirt Road.

entities.name: Dilapidated White Wooden House
entities.identification: The white horizontal-plank house in the central background, with a triangular gable, a damaged roof, and a porch on the left.

entities.name: Dirt Road
entities.identification: The broad grayish-brown bare ground occupying the lower foreground and extending to the front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Grayish-White Sky
entities.identification: The bright, low-contrast sky behind the wooden house and tree branches, with a slight pale grayish-blue tint.

entities.name: Weeds on Both Sides of the Road
entities.identification: The mixed green grass and withered yellow plants on both sides of the road and in front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Dead Tree on the Image-Left
entities.identification: The tree near the left edge with a slender grayish-brown trunk and exposed branches.

entities.name: Distant Wooden Shed on the Image-Right
entities.identification: The low, crooked grayish-brown wooden structure with plank walls in the distant background to the right of the wooden house.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: Person B, who enters the foreground from the right, wearing brownish-tan trousers; from frame 22 of this clip onward, only a narrow strip of a trouser leg is visible at the far right edge, while Person A sits farther away on the road.
